pattern: (?:て|で)?(?:いただけ|頂け)(?:ます|れば)と(?:幸い|ありがた|助かり)
plain: Please do this. Sounds optional, but it is a real request.

pattern: (?:て|で)(?:いただけ|頂け)(?:ます|ない)でしょうか
plain: "Could you…?" = please do it.
Please do: $1 (formal request).

pattern: ご査収(?:ください|くださいませ|のほど)
plain: Please check the attachment / what was sent.
Please do: $1.

pattern: (?:いただき|頂き)たく(?:存じ|思い|お願い)
plain: "I would like you to…" = please do it.

pattern: (?:賜り|たまわり)ますよう
plain: Please grant / give us (very formal request).

pattern: (?:ご返信|ご返答|ご回答|お返事|ご連絡)(?:を|の程|のほど)?(?:お待ちして|いただけ|ください|頂け|お願い)
plain: They expect a reply from you.

pattern: 差し支え(?:なければ|ございませんでしたら|がなければ)
plain: "If it's no trouble…". Sounds optional, but they usually expect you to do it.

pattern: ご遠慮(?:ください|いただけ|願い)
plain: Please DON'T do this (polite prohibition).

pattern: ご放念(?:ください|くださいませ)
plain: Please disregard / forget about it.
Deadline: $1.

pattern: (?:大至急|至急|早急に|取り急ぎご|お早めに|なるべく早く|できるだけ早く)
plain: Urgent: reply or act as soon as possible.

pattern: お手(?:すき|隙|透き)の(?:際|折|とき|時)
plain: "When you have time" = low urgency, but still expected.

pattern: 恐れ入り(?:ます|ますが)
plain: Softener with no meaning of its own. A request usually follows.

pattern: お手数(?:を)?(?:おかけ(?:いたし|し)ますが|ですが|ではございますが)
plain: "Sorry for the trouble" = a request follows.

pattern: (?:大変)?恐縮(?:です|ではございます|ながら)が?
plain: Polite softener, roughly "sorry to ask".

pattern: (?:ご多忙|お忙しい)(?:のところ|中|ところ)
plain: "Knowing you're busy…" = softener before a request.

pattern: 取り急ぎ
plain: Quick note; a fuller message may follow.

pattern: 念のため
plain: "Just to be sure" = a reminder or double-check.

pattern: (?:前向きに)?(?:検討|考慮)(?:させていただきます|させて頂きます|いたします|します)
plain: "We'll consider it". Often a polite no, or not now. Don't count on it.

pattern: (?:難しい|厳しい)(?:状況|かと|です|ところ)
plain: "It's difficult" = no.

pattern: 見送(?:らせて|り|る)
plain: Declined / passing on it this time.

pattern: ご(?:期待|希望)に(?:添え|沿え|お応えでき)
plain: Rejection ("could not meet your hopes").

pattern: ご縁がなかった|貴意に添いかね
plain: Rejection (common in hiring).

pattern: (?:いたし|致し|し)?かねます
plain: "…kanemasu" = we cannot / will not do it.

pattern: (?:承知(?:いたし|致し|し)ました|かしこまりました|承りました)
plain: Understood / OK.

pattern: 拝受(?:いたし|致し|し)ました
plain: Received (your message/file).
